nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements
nodes.label: Climate change agreements

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_000
nodes.question: What are the key features of the Rotterdam Climate Agreement?
nodes.answer: The Rotterdam Climate Agreement focuses on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving air quality, and increasing sustainable energy use in the city to combat climate change.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What role do international agreements play in addressing climate change?
nodes.answer: International agreements influence long-term strategic policies of each country and are fundamental tools for promoting policies that tackle immediate needs sustainably and contribute to a safer future.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What type of literature has emerged regarding International Environmental Agreements (IEAs)?
nodes.answer: Recent literature has focused on the combination of mitigation and adaptation measures within IEAs as tools to combat climate change.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How do Bayramoglu et al. (2018) contribute to the understanding of adaptation and mitigation in climate agreements?
nodes.answer: They study the strategic interaction between mitigation, viewed as a public good, and adaptation, considered a private good in the context of a climate agreement.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_004
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What initiative has the European Union based its actions to mitigate climate change on?
nodes.answer: The European Union has based its actions to mitigate climate change on the European Green Deal.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_005
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How has the European Union coordinated its actions to mitigate climate change?
nodes.answer: The European Union has coordinated its actions to mitigate climate change primarily through the European Green Deal.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_006
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How does the European Union aim to address climate change?
nodes.answer: The European Union aims to address climate change through coordination of actions based on the European Green Deal.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_007
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What general agreement is mentioned in the paragraph regarding CO2 emissions?
nodes.answer: There is a wide agreement about the link of CO2 emissions and economic activity.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_008
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Which initiative has the European Union primarily based its actions to mitigate climate change on?
nodes.answer: The European Union has primarily based its actions on the European Green Deal.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_009
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Which environmental agreement was adopted in 1997 to address CO2 emissions?
nodes.answer: The Kyoto Protocol was adopted in 1997 to work towards curbing CO2 emissions globally.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_010
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What initiative has the European Union implemented to coordinate actions for climate change?
nodes.answer: The European Union has implemented the European Green Deal to coordinate actions to mitigate climate change and promote the green transition.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_011
nodes.label: Regulation
nodes.question: Which environmental agreement was adopted in 1997 to curb CO2 emissions globally?
nodes.answer: The Kyoto Protocol was adopted in 1997 to curb CO2 emissions globally.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Climate change agreements_qna_012
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are the names of some major international climate agreements mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The Kyoto Protocol and COP21 are major international climate agreements mentioned in the paragraph.
